configs.comment: For portal area rendering and entity rendering and particle

Immersive Aeronautics: an Iris shader pack's vanilla-path terrain programs (they draw Sable ships with a pack), like the vanilla terrain entry. Iris's ShaderInstance.getUniform prefixes names with iris_, hence the ship plane's name. ShaderCodeTransformation.IRIS_TERRAIN_SHADERS lists them for MixinShaderInstance.

Immersive Aeronautics: an Iris shader pack's vanilla-path entity, block entity, text and particle programs, like the vanilla entity entry (their vertices are camera-relative, Iris's iris_Position). Without them a portal view with a pack showed everything between the portal camera and the far portal. ShaderCodeTransformation.IRIS_ENTITY_SHADERS lists them for MixinShaderInstance.
